dialect.detail: Micro Focus COBOL with $SET LINKCOUNT directive, COMP-5, CRT STATUS, CURSOR IS, CONSOLE IS CRT — typical Micro Focus personal/workstation COBOL for DOS/Windows environment; GNU GPL licensed accounting package by J W Lemmon (APAC)

purpose.domain_detail: Accounts Receivable debtor statements module of a small-business accounting package (PASTEL-style, AllFORMS ref A/10067/A); prints debtor statements with ageing, consolidated statements, and range-based printing
purpose.summary: STMF05 is the debtor statements printing program for an Accounts Receivable system. It reads debtor master records, transaction history, and control files to produce formatted statements showing aged balances (current, 1-month, 2-month, 3-month+). It supports consolidated statements, range-based printing across workstations, and archival of statement runs to dated history files (AR_Ayymm/AR_Tyymm).

notable_features: CRT STATUS / CURSOR IS / CONSOLE IS CRT (interactive screen support)
63 COPY statements for modular file/record definitions
REDEFINES used extensively for multi-purpose print line layouts
GNU GPL license embedded in SECURITY paragraph
WS-CHECK field containing obfuscated author name 'aeWlimemnomLalismJ'
verdict.notes: Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 3213 lines. Encoding is latin-1 with box-drawing characters (X'B3', X'CD', '³', '°') used for screen borders. The $SET directive and COMP-5 usage strongly indicate Micro Focus COBOL. Program is part of a larger accounting suite with many copybooks (DEBTOR, DBTRAN, PARAM, SHARED, etc.).
